test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
'Z + Y' means 'Y is the son of Z'.

'Z $ Y' means 'Y is the father of Z'.

'Y % Z' means 'Y is the son-in-law of Z'.

'Z – Y' means 'Y is the wife of Z'.

'Y * Z' means 'Z is the brother of Y'.

'Y # Z' means 'Z is the only sister of Y'

Which two symbols can sequentially replace the question marks (?) in the following expression to show that ‘D is the wife of W’?

W % O – B ? C ? D
solution:
Let us first decode the given data:

 
 

 **Code**
 +
 $
 %
 -
 *
 #
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Son
 Father
 Son-in-law
 wife
 brother
 sister
 
 

Family Chart:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdd0b30cffaf954e65ff899730e11e9e4ceb2b8a3106f0f1cf7dc6cc2718c84.png] 

Given: W % O – B ? C ? D

**Option 1) % and – **

After interchanging we get: W % O – B % C - D

1) W % O means W is the son-in-law of O.

2) O - B means B is the wife of O.

3) B % C means B is son-in-law of C. **(Here B is not a son-in-law of C because B is a female)**

4) C - D means D is wife of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47b98af6229fae0bda0500a0ba3785b7aa7e15454150f3f742921127cd3ad864.png] 

It is false because, here B is the female and given relation is wrong.

**Option 2) $ and +**

After interchanging we get: W % O – B $ C + D

1) W % O means W is the son-in-law of O.

2) O - B means B is wife of O.

3) B $ C means C is father of B.

4) C + D means D is son of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70e2bc6c36f89318ed964157168256032154beddbc9c0129f36b8d8a9a6bab02.png] 

It is false because, here D is the uncle of W.

**Option 3) + and #**

After interchanging we get: W % O – B + C # D

1) W % O means W is the son-in-law of O.

2) O - B means B is wife of O.

3) B + C means C is son of B.

4) C # D means D is only sister of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97a598929d6f28a1fb809c58ddf9d2522d33a809e419822ef1bc408af906496c.png] 

**It is true, here D is the wife of W.**

**Option 4) + and -**

After interchanging we get: W % O – B + C - D

1) W % O means W is the son-in-law of O.

2) O - B means B is wife of O.

3) B + C means C is son of B.

4) C - D means D is wife of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47b98af6229fae0bda0500a0ba3785b7aa7e15454150f3f742921127cd3ad864.png] 

It is false because here, D is the sister-in-law of W. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"+ and #".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** D has to be the wife of W which means she needs to be female and going by all symbols we can see that only the - and # symbols represent female but the "-" symbol means wife and that is not possible because this would mean D is the wife of C so the only symbol left is # and the answer is 3rd.
